text: いま　おれたち　チャットちゅう　なんだ！

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ (from のだ) explains the situation. This is a rough, male-sounding style. チャットちゅう　なんだ = 'we're in the middle of chatting, you see'.

patterns.name: 〜ちゅう
patterns.explanation: ちゅう after a noun means in the middle of it. チャットちゅう = 'in the middle of a chat'.
